ja299:1.1: Pure tuvaṃ sīlavataṃ sakāse okkandikaṃ kīḷasi assamamhi, karoh' are makkaṭiyāni makkaṭa, na taṃ mayaṃ sīlavataṃ ramāmā 'ti.
ja299:2.1: Sutā hi mayhaṃ paramā visuddhi Komāyaputtassa bahussutassa, mā dāni maṃ maññi tuvaṃ yathā pure, jhānāniyuttā viharāma āvuso ti.
ja299:3.1: Sace pi selasmiṃ vapeyyu bījaṃ devo ca vasse n' eva hi taṃ ruheyya, sutā hi tayā paramā visuddhi, ārā tuvaṃ makkaṭa jhānabhūmiyā ti.
